name: Ganga Swarupa Punah Lagna Arthik Sahay Scheme
benefit: - **Assistance through Direct Bank Transfer (DBT): ₹**25,000/- will be credited directly to the beneficiary&#39;s savings account through Direct Bank Transfer (DBT).  - **Assistance for National Savings Certificates:** **₹**25,000/- will be issued to the beneficiary in the form of National Savings Certificates (NSC), providing a secure and long-term savings option.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat.
   1. The applicant must be aged between 18 to 50 years.
   1. The applicant must be a beneficiary of the &amp;quot;Ganga Swarup Economic Assistance Scheme&amp;quot;.
